code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = [v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v not in (0, bg)]
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in special]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    boundary = [grid[r][c] for r,c in cells if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)]
    outer = Counter(boundary).most_common(1)[0][0]
    inner = next(v for v in special if v != outer)
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[r][c] = outer if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1) else inner
    return out
'''
(prog/'task-bca0a42a.py').write_text(code)
